items.name: Compliance Personnel Verification (SFI & RST)
items.description: Verifies SFI (Significant Financial Interest) disclosure status and Research Security Training (RST) completion for every person named on a federal research proposal. Operator uploads three workflow documents together — the VERAS proposal package, the institutional SFI disclosure records, and the most recent daily RST completion spreadsheet — and the workflow returns a per-person compliance matrix with non-compliance priorities and overall summary counts. Output conforms to the compliance-personnel-verification-udm component schema. The runtime mirrors the ui-insight/ProcessMapping compliance-personnel-verification workflow's two parallel Extraction tasks plus a Consolidation Prompt.

data.name: extract-personnel-identification
data.prompt:
You are extracting the personnel-identification block from a
VERAS proposal package. Mirrors TASK-01 of the source
ProcessMapping compliance-personnel-verification workflow.

Be 100% accurate. Quote names verbatim. Do not invent personnel.

Sources to read (all uploaded as workflow documents):
- VERAS Section 6.6 (SFI Disclosures) — lists every person on
  the project who requires an SFI disclosure.
- VERAS Section 2 (PI and Senior Key Personnel) — lists the PI,
  Co-PIs, and senior / key personnel with their roles and
  departments.
- Proposal Information (cover page) — proposal_type and
  sponsor_type.

For each searchset item return the document's stated values:
- section_66_personnel: JSON array of strings (names listed in
  Section 6.6). Empty array if Section 6.6 is not present.
- section_2_personnel: JSON array of {name, role, department}
  objects. role is one of "PI", "Co-PI", "Senior/Key Personnel".
  department is null when not stated. MUST contain at least one
  entry (every proposal has a PI).
- consolidated_personnel: deduplicated union of the two lists
  as {name, role, department, source_sections} objects.
  source_sections is an array containing one or both of "6.6"
  and "2". Use the Section 2 role and department when a person
  appears in both sections.
- proposal_type: one of "Research", "Non-Research",
  "Not specified".
- sponsor_type: one of "Federal", "State", "Non-Federal",
  "Not specified".
- sfi_rst_required: JSON boolean. true ONLY when proposal_type
  == "Research" AND sponsor_type == "Federal"; false otherwise.
- personnel_discrepancies: JSON array of strings describing
  differences between Section 6.6 and Section 2 (e.g., "Jane
  Smith appears in Section 2 but is missing from Section 6.6").
  Empty array when the lists match.

data.name: extract-compliance-status
data.prompt:
You are verifying SFI disclosure and RST completion status for
every person named on the federal research proposal. Mirrors
TASK-02 of the source ProcessMapping
compliance-personnel-verification workflow.

Sources to read (all uploaded as workflow documents):
- Institutional SFI disclosure records (export, scanned, or
  extracted).
- Most recent daily RST completion spreadsheet from UI Bridge.

Be 100% accurate. Quote dates verbatim and convert to ISO
YYYY-MM-DD. Do NOT assume compliance. A person missing from the
SFI records is "Not Found" (not "Valid"). A person missing from
the RST spreadsheet is "Incomplete" (not "Complete"). When two
records could match the same name and you cannot disambiguate
by department, emit status "Review Required" rather than
guessing.

When the SFI records document or the RST spreadsheet is not
provided as a workflow document, emit null values where required
and capture the gap as a single-string entry in
notes_about_missing_sources.

For each searchset item return the document's stated values:

- sfi_verification: JSON array of per-person
  {name, disclosure_found, disclosure_date, days_since_disclosure,
   valid_within_365_days, status} objects. One entry per person
  on the consolidated personnel list. status is one of
  "Valid", "Expiring Soon", "Expired", "Not Found",
  "Review Required". Use ISO YYYY-MM-DD for disclosure_date.
  days_since_disclosure is a JSON integer; null when
  disclosure_found is false.

- rst_spreadsheet_date: ISO YYYY-MM-DD date of the RST
  spreadsheet used.
- rst_spreadsheet_source: source label
  (e.g., "UI Bridge daily export").
- rst_records: JSON array of per-person
  {name, found_in_spreadsheet, completion_date, status} objects.
  One entry per person on the consolidated personnel list.
  status is one of "Complete", "Incomplete", "Review Required".

- notes_about_missing_sources: short string describing any
  source document that was not provided, or null when both the
  SFI records and the RST spreadsheet were present.

data.name: compliance-personnel-verification-consolidation
data.prompt:
You are the consolidation step of the Compliance Personnel
Verification (SFI & RST) workflow. You receive two extraction
outputs from the previous step (personnel identification +
compliance status verification) and must emit a SINGLE JSON
object that validates against the
compliance-personnel-verification-udm@0.1.0 schema (schema.json
in the component directory).

## Output contract

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no closing commentary,
no markdown fences. If your runtime requires fenced output, wrap
in a single ```json ... ``` block and emit nothing outside it.

Top-level keys (in this order): `proposal_metadata`,
`personnel_identification`, `sfi_verification`,
`rst_verification`, `non_compliant_personnel`,
`verification_status`.

## Field-by-field assembly

### proposal_metadata (from extract-personnel-identification)

Build:
{
  "proposal_type": <one of the three enum values>,
  "sponsor_type": <one of the four enum values>,
  "sfi_rst_required": <JSON boolean>
}
All three are required.

### personnel_identification (from extract-personnel-identification)

Pass through section_66_personnel, section_2_personnel,
consolidated_personnel, and personnel_discrepancies as the
extractor returned them. section_2_personnel must be non-empty
(a placeholder entry is not appropriate here — if the proposal
has no PI, fail loudly by returning an error rather than
emitting fabricated personnel).

### sfi_verification (from extract-compliance-status)

Pass through the array. One entry per person on
consolidated_personnel. When the SFI records source was not
provided, every entry should have disclosure_found: false,
disclosure_date: null, days_since_disclosure: null,
valid_within_365_days: null, status: "Not Found", and the
consolidator must add a notes_about_missing_sources entry to
verification_status.notes.

### rst_verification (from extract-compliance-status)

Build:
{
  "spreadsheet_date": <ISO YYYY-MM-DD>,
  "spreadsheet_source": <source label>,
  "records": <the rst_records array, one entry per person>
}
When the RST spreadsheet was not provided, spreadsheet_date
remains required by the schema — emit the date of the
attempted lookup (today) and spreadsheet_source as
"Not provided", with every record set to
found_in_spreadsheet: false, completion_date: null,
status: "Incomplete". Capture the missing-source gap in
verification_status.notes.

### non_compliant_personnel (derive from sfi_verification + rst_verification)

Walk consolidated_personnel. For each person, emit one entry
per compliance issue (SFI and / or RST) using these rules:

- SFI status "Not Found" -> issue: "SFI disclosure not found",
  required_action: "Submit SFI disclosure before proposal
  submission", priority: "Critical".
- SFI status "Expired" -> issue: "SFI disclosure expired",
  required_action: "Renew SFI disclosure immediately",
  priority: "High".
- SFI status "Expiring Soon" -> issue: "SFI disclosure expires
  within 30 days", required_action: "Renew SFI disclosure
  proactively", priority: "Medium".
- SFI status "Review Required" -> issue: "SFI disclosure
  ambiguous match", required_action: "Manual SFI lookup
  required", priority: "Critical".
- RST status "Incomplete" -> issue: "RST not completed",
  required_action: "Complete RST training before proposal
  submission", priority: "Critical".
- RST status "Review Required" -> issue: "RST record ambiguous
  match", required_action: "Manual RST lookup required",
  priority: "Critical".
- SFI status "Valid" AND RST status "Complete" -> no entry.

Emit an empty array when every person is compliant.

### verification_status (derive)

{
  "total_personnel_checked": consolidated_personnel.length,
  "sfi_compliant_count": count where sfi_verification status
    == "Valid",
  "rst_compliant_count": count where rst_verification status
    == "Complete",
  "fully_compliant_count": count where SFI is "Valid" AND
    RST is "Complete",
  "overall_status": one of "All Compliant",
    "Non-Compliance Found", "Not Applicable",
  "notes": null OR a single string concatenating
    notes_about_missing_sources from extract-compliance-status
    with any disambiguation warnings.
}

overall_status rules:
- "Not Applicable" when proposal_metadata.sfi_rst_required ==
  false.
- "All Compliant" when sfi_rst_required is true AND
  non_compliant_personnel is empty.
- "Non-Compliance Found" when sfi_rst_required is true AND
  non_compliant_personnel is non-empty.

## Quality bar

- Output validates against schema.json (draft 2020-12).
- Counts (total_personnel_checked, sfi_compliant_count, etc.)
  are JSON integers >= 0.
- Dates (disclosure_date, completion_date, spreadsheet_date)
  use ISO YYYY-MM-DD.
- Booleans (disclosure_found, found_in_spreadsheet,
  sfi_rst_required, valid_within_365_days) are JSON booleans.
- No fabricated compliance. When a source is missing, the
  contract emits non-compliant defaults and captures the gap
  in verification_status.notes.

validation_plan.check_description: Verify Section 6.6 and Section 2 personnel are cross-referenced and consolidated.
Verify every person on the consolidated list has an SFI status record.
Verify every person on the consolidated list has an RST status record.
Verify SFI disclosure dates are evaluated against a 365-day validity window.
